new24_001.full: A realistic documentary photograph of a large group of twelve tall blue industrial gas cylinders stored upright inside a rectangular blue-painted steel cylinder storage cage at a Chinese construction site. The cage has four vertical steel posts, sturdy horizontal crossbars, an open top, and a clearly visible rectangular frame surrounding the entire group of cylinders. The cylinders are densely arranged in two rows, with weathered blue paint, rust marks, and individual metal valves. Wet concrete ground with puddles and reflections, reinforcing steel bars, concrete structures, and a tower crane in the background. Overcast rainy weather, eye-level three-quarter view, natural industrial lighting, realistic construction site photography.
new24_001.evaluation: A realistic construction-site photograph of twelve tall blue industrial gas cylinders standing upright in two rows inside an open-top rectangular blue steel storage cage, on wet concrete in rainy weather.

Soft natural daylight entering from the open side of the shed, medium-distance eye-level photograph, realistic construction environment.
new24_010.evaluation: A realistic construction-site photograph of eight tall silver-gray industrial gas cylinders standing in a compact irregular cluster beside a concrete column in a partially covered storage area, with no enclosing cage or shared securing frame.
